coordinator_attestation.statement: The coordinator actually spawned these 60 distinct worker agents in ten waves of six, observed completion of all 60 original assignments, and received their completed reports. Same-agent follow-ups, repeated tests and supplemental probes are not additional agents. The root coordinator is excluded. This records completed work, not a claim that full governance or native performance execution passed.

limitations: File hashes bind the recorded reports; invocation and assignment completion are attested from actual coordinator tool history, not inferred from file presence.
Testing, native execution, experimental hypothesis satisfaction, hosted CI and phase acceptance retain their separate explicit evidence scopes.
